# Board cards drop dueDate after CardEditor saves it

## Context

On `dev` (`74d999124c`), `Neo.board.CardModel` declares `dueDate` (`src/board/CardModel.mjs:59`) and `Neo.board.CardEditor` builds a `Due date` picker by default on every `CardModel` board (`src/board/CardEditor.mjs:92,106,439,686-690`). Opening the card editor on `examples/board/basic` (or any minimal `Neo.board.Container` built from the Kanban guide), picking a due date, and clicking **Save** writes `yyyy-mm-dd` onto `record.dueDate` — and paints nothing on the card. Identified in the planning-family source check ([`#21346` comment 6982869553](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21346#issuecomment-6982869553): *"dueDate is edited but never drawn"* / *"Board: a date card item"*) and actionable under the `v14.0` convergence pass on #21346.

No curated contributor labels: self-assigned maintainer fix landing for the `v14.0` release cut and unblocking the date-card slot of #21346.

## The Problem

- `learn/guides/datahandling/Board.md:66-67` states that `Neo.board.CardModel` declares the fields the board and its default card items read (`id`, `title`, `description`, `status`, `lane`, `order`, `assignees`, `tags`, `progress`, `color` and `dueDate`), yet §6 (`Board.md:208-216`), `src/board/CardItems.mjs:32-121`, and `src/board/Container.mjs:68` implement and list only five built-in card item types (`title`, `text`, `tags`, `progress`, `avatars`).
- Because `CardEditor` offers `Due date` out of the box whenever the store's model declares `dueDate` (`#21222`), saving a due date in `CardEditor` succeeds silently without updating the card's rendered body unless every consumer hand-registers a custom renderer via `registerCardItem`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `"Neo.board.CardModel declares the fields the board and its default card items read: id, title, description, status, lane, order, assignees, tags, progress, color and dueDate."` (`learn/guides/datahandling/Board.md:66-67`) and `"@summary The card of a board: the fields the board reads, and the fields its default card items render."` (`src/board/CardModel.mjs:4`).
- `src/board/CardItems.mjs` is a module of pure `(record, item, card) -> vdom | null` renderers; `Card#renderItems()` (`src/board/Card.mjs:342-354`) stamps deterministic node IDs (`<card>__<type>[__<field>]`) and filters `null` items so records without `dueDate` emit zero extra DOM nodes.
- `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs:35-45` establishes the planning-family convention of caching `Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {...options, timeZone: 'UTC'})` over wall-date UTC components so formatted calendar labels stay timezone- and clock-deterministic across workers and SSR/Playwright runs; moving that helper to `Neo.util.Date.formatWall` (with `TimeAxisHeader.formatWall` delegating to it) lets `CardItems.mjs` share both `DateUtil.formatWall` and `DateUtil.convertToyyyymmdd` without importing a component class.
- All five shipped board themes (`resources/css/theme-{neo-dark,neo-light,dark,light,cyberpunk}/board/Container.css`) already define `--neo-board-card-hover-border-color` and `--neo-board-badge-color` (`>= 5.5:1` WCAG 2.2 AA contrast against `--neo-board-card-background` across all five themes, whereas `--neo-board-card-muted-color` over `--neo-board-badge-background` drops to `3.74:1` in `neo-light`), so styling `.neo-board-card-due-date` as an outlined `4px` badge in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` works across every theme without hardcoded colors, visually distinguishes dates from filled pill tags, and shares one footer row with `.neo-board-card-avatars` when both are present.

## The Fix

1. **`src/util/Date.mjs` & `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs`:**
   - Move `formatWall(locale, options, wall, wallEnd)` and its cached `Intl.DateTimeFormat` `Map` into `Neo.util.Date.formatWall`, keeping `TimeAxisHeader.formatWall` as a one-line delegate.
2. **`src/board/CardItems.mjs` (`cardItems.dueDate`):**
   - Add built-in `dueDate(record, item)` reading `record[item.field || 'dueDate']`.
   - Return `null` when missing, empty, or an invalid `Date`.
   - Normalize `Date` instances via `DateUtil.convertToyyyymmdd` and ISO date/datetime strings (`YYYY-MM-DD...`) into a semantic `{tag: 'time', cls: ['neo-board-card-due-date'], datetime: iso, title: iso, text}` VDOM node.
   - Format `text` deterministically via `DateUtil.formatWall(item.locale || 'en-US', item.formatOptions || {month: 'short', day: 'numeric'}, wallDate)` prefixed by `item.prefix ?? 'Due'` (e.g. `'Due Dec 15'`; `prefix: ''` or `false` omits the prefix), with optional `item.formatter(value, record)` override.
3. **`src/board/Container.mjs` & `src/board/CardModel.mjs`:**
   - Include `{type: 'dueDate'}` in `Neo.board.Container#cardItems_` (`[{type: 'title'}, {type: 'tags'}, {type: 'progress'}, {type: 'dueDate'}, {type: 'avatars'}]`) and align `CardModel` / `Card.css` JSDoc item lists.
4. **`resources/css/src/board/Card.css`:**
   - Style `.neo-board-card-due-date` as a compact outlined tabular-numeral badge (`border: 1px solid var(--neo-board-card-hover-border-color); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--neo-board-badge-color)`), and pair `.neo-board-card-due-date + .neo-board-card-avatars` on one shared footer row while preserving full-width rows for every other card item.
5. **`learn/guides/datahandling/Board.md`:**
   - Update §6 (`What a Card Shows`) default `cardItems` array and built-in item list to document `dueDate`.
6. **Tests (`test/playwright/unit/util/Date.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/unit/board/Card.spec.mjs` & `test/playwright/e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs`):**
   - Add unit tests for `DateUtil.formatWall` and `cardItems.dueDate` (ISO date string, ISO timestamp, `Date` instance, custom `field`, custom `prefix` / `formatter` / `formatOptions`, empty/null/invalid `Date` returning `null`, and `Card` rendering/updating `dueDate`).
   - Extend `BasicNL.spec.mjs` to set a due date through `CardEditor`, save, verify `<time class="neo-board-card-due-date" datetime="...">` (`'Due Dec 15'`) renders on the live card with `>= 4.5:1` contrast, and verify clearing removes the badge.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `cardItems.dueDate` in `src/board/CardItems.mjs` renders ISO date strings (`'2026-12-01'`), ISO timestamps, and `Date` instances into `{tag: 'time', cls: ['neo-board-card-due-date'], datetime: '2026-12-01', ...}`, supports `item.field`, `item.locale`, `item.prefix`, `item.formatOptions`, and `item.formatter`, and returns `null` when empty, null, or invalid.
- [ ] `Neo.board.Container#cardItems_` includes `{type: 'dueDate'}`, leaving cards without `dueDate` unchanged (`0` extra DOM nodes) while rendering saved `CardEditor` due dates immediately.
- [ ] `.neo-board-card-due-date` in `resources/css/src/board/Card.css` uses existing `--neo-board-*` theme tokens with `>= 4.5:1` WCAG contrast across shipped themes and shares one footer row with adjacent `.neo-board-card-avatars`.
- [ ] `learn/guides/datahandling/Board.md` §6 documents `dueDate` in the default `cardItems` array and built-in renderer list.
- [ ] Unit tests in `test/playwright/unit/board/Card.spec.mjs` and E2E verification in `test/playwright/e2e/board/BasicNL.spec.mjs` (plus existing board unit & E2E suites) pass.

## Out of Scope

- Implicit `new Date()` wall-clock "overdue" coloring inside `cardItems.dueDate` (would couple card rendering to test/capture clock time and misclassify completed `'done'` cards).
- Shared Portal catalog data files (`examples.json`, `example-captures.json`, `seo.json`, `#21539`).
- A new standalone `examples/board/` demonstration folder (separate example leaf under #21346).

## Avoided Traps

- **Calling `new Date(isoString)` with local-timezone getters:** `new Date('2026-12-01')` parses as UTC midnight, which shifts to `'Nov 30'` in negative UTC offsets when formatted in local time; parsing `YYYY-MM-DD` components into `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)` and formatting with `timeZone: 'UTC'` (`DateUtil.formatWall`) keeps calendar dates exact in every timezone.
- **Using `--neo-board-card-muted-color` over `--neo-board-badge-background` or stacking `dueDate` above `avatars`:** Muted-on-badge drops to `3.74:1` in `neo-theme-neo-light` (below WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 `4.5:1`), bare dates without `Due` look like category tags, and stacking `dueDate` above `avatars` wastes an extra vertical row per card; an outlined `4px` `Due <date>` badge sharing the avatar footer row solves all three.
- **Formatting with ambient `new Date()` overdue checks:** Breaks screenshot/test determinism and flags completed cards as overdue.
